rust_summary: the entities an explosion is about to hurt and push, to spare some (`native_explosion_entities`).
doc_summary: `native_explosion_entities(dimension, center, entities)` (server) runs after `native_explosion_detonate`, before an explosion at `center` hurts and pushes anything: `entities` holds the ids of the entities in its reach (`ServerExplosion.hurtEntities`), players aside, which `native_living_incoming_damage` hears. Take out the ids to spare: they are neither hurt nor pushed. Bundles need "hooks": @API:explosion_entities@.
